presentation.title: See the whole control plane from one command tree
presentation.body: Stado is the operator entry point for the Wisent fleet: jobs and queues, hosts and services, releases, storage, credentials, and product installations all have their own command groups. Start with read commands such as status, list, show, catalog, and overview; commands that change the fleet say what they act on and expose their required target or apply flag.

presentation.title: Inspect real state before changing it
presentation.body: Use stado --help to discover the command tree, then ask a command group for its own help. Read-only commands return the same fleet and catalogue records that mutating operations use, so an inspection is not a demo or a separate sample configuration. This walkthrough never changes a host, service, product installation, or secret.

presentation.title: List the real Wisent product catalogue
presentation.body: Run stado product catalog to read the catalogue used by Stado's product lifecycle commands. It prints the products and their installable surfaces without installing, updating, removing, or contacting a host. The journey completes only after that real command succeeds; merely viewing this screen does not record success.
presentation.result: The canonical Wisent products and each product's installable surfaces
